The scenario is a world where supernatural creatures come from a "Blue Fog". Both characters work for the same company that exterminates monsters.


📂 SUMIN | 178CM | 38 YEARS OLD

A high-ranking officer. He carries the burden of many deceased comrades, including his twin sister. He believes it was his fault she died. He does not want to live, but understands he is wasting her sacrifice if he dies. Instead, he spends his days somewhat aimlessly, trying to find anything that is "entertaining" or "interesting".

He is fox-like and charming, naturally attracting people to his outward personality. He is very fickle, but shrewd at the same time, viewing other people as either beneficial or detrimental to his personal goals. He has no issue with leaving or abandoning others. He is a lonely person, but has convinced himself that it is an inevitability of life.

MOTIFS: Night ocean. Abandoned temples. Summer evenings. Sparklers.


❓ SYCAMORE | 188CM | 38 YEARS OLD

A doctor by trade, with keen intellect and a knack for medicine. He can seem silly and overly lighthearted at times, but he means well.

Calm and serene. He seems to have a smile on his face at all times. He exudes a gentle aura, and though he can act childish as a joke, people typically regard him as a kind person. In truth, although he pretends to be warm-hearted without any ulterior motives, he is actually quite the apathetic person who has endured many losses of loved ones and a lot of grief in his past. He pretends to be friendly and kind because he does not think he deserves to grieve.

MOTIFS: Gingko leaves. Autumn days. Operating room table. Shattered glass.

※ Please note the two (2) moles Sycamore has under both of his eyes, and the scar over his right eye. He is frequently covered in scars, bruises, and bandages, and is always wearing gloves.


📂❓ RELATIONSHIP: They have an unconventional relationship that is very toxic and push-and-pull. In front of their colleagues, they look like a playful duo that enjoy teasing and flirting with each other. In actuality, they are constantly pushing each other's boundaries in a twisted game to see who "breaks down" first. There's no purpose to this game; both of them are simply bored with the lives they are forced to live and they are "fun" challenges to each other.

Sumin and Sycamore have many deeper similarities that neither of them are willing to fully disclose. It is in front of Sumin that Sycamore feels most comfortable dropping his "kind-hearted mask." They know enough about each other that they know how to say cruel things to each other, and they are both so reckless that neither of them truly have boundaries with each other.

Sumin and Sycamore are always smiling. Sometimes, these smiles are playful. Sometimes, these smiles are wicked.

📂 --> ❓: You do not matter to me, so you cannot be my burden.

❓ --> 📂: The less I matter to you, the more I want to burden you.


The pose and composition are entirely up to you. Please feel free to turn down this request for any reason. Thank you for your consideration!
